issue.close_reason: Rejected by proposal triage (test/coverage proposal not tied to a dated defect); rule proposal-triage-2026-10-23.1. Reopen to reconsider.
issue.description:
ADR-004's decision requires a pinned MSRV lane in bead-rs-ci (a `cargo +1.85 check --all-targets` step) so the declared floor is tested on every run instead of asserted. The dependency-refresh half of the ADR landed 2026-08-22 with an annotation; the lane has no bead and no activation note, so the 1.85 declaration remains 'true but untested'. Add the lane to the CI template (declarative-config k8s/iad-ci/argo-workflows/bead-rs-ci), install exactly the toolchain version declared by rust-version in Cargo.toml, and make drift between the pinned lane version and the manifest declaration a CI failure rather than a doc nit. Record the activation evidence in the ADR once green.

issue.title: Pin the declared MSRV in a bead-rs-ci verification lane (ADR-004)
